verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Datadog exposes its own official MCP server (docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/), letting other AI agents call Datadog's tools — this is the server/provider role, not Datadog acting as an MCP client that can plug in and use external MCP servers' tools. No evidence exists of Bits AI or any Datadog feature consuming third-party MCP servers.
